decision.question: Compared with the source image, has the requested change—putting a frog in the toilet—made progress, and is that requested change complete?
decision.criteria: Pass if the edited image visibly shows at least one frog inside the toilet bowl, satisfying the requested placement. Fail if the edited image clearly shows no progress toward placing a frog in the toilet. Do not mark the requested change partial or incomplete solely because additional frogs appear elsewhere; the instruction specifies neither a count nor an exclusion of other placements. Unknown if the images do not provide enough evidence to determine whether a frog is inside the bowl, or if there is a specific visible ambiguity that prevents deciding whether the requested placement is satisfied.
decision.binding: Compare the source and edited images. Use the toilet in the source image to identify its bowl, and assess whether a visible frog is placed inside that bowl. Treat frogs on the raised lid or floor as additional placements, not by themselves as evidence that the requested bowl placement is incomplete.
